conviction_note: Q3 itself should land inside the RMB400-500M non-GAAP guide that consensus already sits in (the company hit its Q1 guide at the top and its Q2 guide once a RMB500M one-off tax charge is added back), so the reported quarter is near-neutral; the print turns on the Q4 guide. Management itself said in August that C-M2 was rising sharply, normalisation needs 'at least 2 to 3 quarters', funding costs are rising and it would be 'extra cautious' for the rest of 2026, and a new CEO (the former chief risk officer, in post since 21 Sep) gives this call. Against that sit a price of 1.9x forward earnings, net cash and deposits of about 2.4x market cap, and a buyback suspended since late June that could restart. The last four prints all sold off on guide cuts (-8% to -19%), so p_up 45 with abs 15 gives -1.5, close to the -1.8 sum of the findings. The two numbers agree in sign; the scaled one stays small because the bar has already been reset hard (stock -76% from its high).

findings.finding: Q3 non-GAAP net income is likely to land inside the RMB400-500M guide, which is above the RMB400-425M implied by the $0.46-0.49 consensus. In 2026 the company landed at the top of its Q1 guide (RMB945.9M against RMB900-950M) and inside its Q2 guide (RMB900-980M) once the disclosed RMB500M one-off tax accrual is added back to the RMB454.9M reported. The Q3 guide was set on 25 Aug, with July volume (-15%) and early-August credit already known.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has not been paid for in-guide quarters. In Mar 2026 it fell 8.45% (StockTitan) and in May 2026 14.1% (longbridge), each time with the quarter near guide and a lower next-quarter guide. The reaction runs on the guide, not on the quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: consensus already sits inside the guide. If the market expected a miss below the guide, consensus would sit below RMB400M. The only unpriced part is the small gap between the Street's lower-half number and a mid-to-upper landing.
findings.independence: Q2 actuals and the Q3 guide come from a different document, the Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/385508/qfin-holdings-announces-second-quarter-and-interim-2026-unaudited-financial-results-and-declares-semi-annual-dividend). The Earnings Whispers preview puts consensus near the middle of the guide (https://finviz.com/news/423403/qfins-profit-floor-faces-its-first-test-as-credit-stress-and-funding-costs-bite).

findings.finding: The Q4 guide is likely to step down again from Q3's RMB400-500M. On the Q2 call management said C-M2 'rose sharply in recent weeks' and would rise noticeably in Q3. It said normalisation needs 'at least 2 to 3 quarters', that August risk tightening went further than July, that volume will not return to Q2 levels soon, and that external funding costs rose about 25bp in Jul-Aug and will trend up through H2. It took an 'extra cautious approach' for the rest of 2026. The Earnings Whispers preview adds that first-payment defaults rose about 20% month on month in August. Q4 2025 non-GAAP was RMB1,070.6M, and there is no sourced Q4 2026 consensus to compare against.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last four prints each cut the forward guide and each sold off: Nov 2025 -14.6% in the overnight session (itiger 'Q3业绩及Q4展望不及预期'), Mar 2026 -8.45%, May 2026 -14.1%, and Aug 2026 -18.9% (Aug 26) on the RMB400-500M Q3 guide.
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced: the stock has halved since the Aug guide, which partly prices it, and it trades at 1.86x forward earnings. But the forward EPS behind that P/E (about $2.52 a year) and the $13.29 mean target imply recovery estimates well above a Q3 run rate of about $0.46 a quarter. If analysts had marked down for a further step down in Q4, the forward P/E would not read under 2x on a recovering EPS line. Sized capped because the Q4 bar is unsourced.
findings.independence: Huxiu/消金界 analysis dated 2026-09-09 (https://www.huxiu.com/article/4889794.html) says Qfin cut credit limits and approval rates in August, that risk indicators keep rising short term after the late-June event and the July collection crackdown, and that the industry turn comes in late 2026 to early 2027 at the earliest. The Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-11-16 reports the FPD +20% figure (https://finviz.com/news/423403/qfins-profit-floor-faces-its-first-test-as-credit-stress-and-funding-costs-bite). Both partly restate the same call.

findings.finding: Q4 costs face two rule-driven headwinds. The eight-agency 金融产品网络营销管理办法 took effect on 30 Sep 2026: it bans collecting user information on intermediate pages (中间页) and requires third-party traffic to jump directly to the lender's page, which lengthens the conversion path and raises acquisition cost. Industry external funding costs are also up 25-30bp since July. Partly offsetting: industry acquisition competition has eased as long-tail platforms exit, and head platforms keep their traffic entrances (Huxiu, 16 Oct).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None specific: cost lines have not been the stated driver of a reaction. The reactions have run on the profit guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The rule is public, and its Qfin-specific cost effect is first visible in the Q4 guide and commentary tonight. If it were priced, the Q4-sensitive estimates would already sit below Q3, and nothing sourced shows that.
findings.independence: Industry proxy: the company has not confirmed an impact. A second Huxiu article of 2026-10-16 (https://m.huxiu.com/article/4898040.html) confirms the 30 Sep effective date and that funding pressure is industry-wide, and notes acquisition competition has eased, which is the offset.

findings.finding: Capital return optionality is large against the market cap. At 30 Jun cash, restricted cash, short-term investments and security deposits were about RMB10.6B (about $1.49B). Convertible notes outstanding are only about $113M after $577M of principal was repurchased for $502M, against a $572M market cap. Buybacks were suspended in late June 'to build additional financial buffer', with a stated intent to keep 'a reasonable shareholder return policy over the long run'. Any restart or new program on tonight's call, the first under the new CEO, would be a large positive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2024: the stock rose 5.97% intraday on Q3 results plus a buyback (itiger 异动解读, https://itiger.com/news/1102320130). Capital return has been bought on this name before.
findings.why_not_priced: A stock at 0.4x its own liquid-asset buffer with a buyback the market expected to resume would not trade there. The price assumes the cash stays trapped as a buffer, and management's own August language supports that. The upside is a low-probability, high-size event, so the size is small.
findings.independence: The suspension and the buffer language come from the Q2 call transcript (https://www.webull.ca/news-detail/15479261165798400). The convert repurchase detail comes from the Q1 release (https://finviz.com/news/357151/qfin-holdings-announces-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results). Earnings Whispers names a buyback update as a factor to watch.

findings.finding: On 20 Sep the board replaced CEO Haisheng Wu with Yan Zheng, effective 21 Sep. Zheng has been chief risk officer since July 2020, and the chairman cited his risk-management background. Tonight is Zheng's first report and call, which raises the odds of conservative provisioning and a conservative Q4 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None: this is the first print under a new CEO.
findings.why_not_priced: The change is public. What has not been priced is how a risk officer turned CEO sets his first guide; that is inference, so the size is small.
findings.independence: Capital.com report of the same change (https://capital.com/en-gb/news/qfin-names-yan-zheng-ceo-replacing-haisheng-wu). It is the same fact, not a separate signal, and it acts through the same guide as finding 2.

findings.finding: Chinese household credit demand stayed weak into Q4. The PBoC's October 2026 data show total RMB loans down RMB100bn in October (RMB320bn more of a fall than a year earlier) and household loans down RMB1.46tn over the first ten months.
findings.why_not_priced: Public macro data, mostly priced. It is filed as a small proxy because Qfin's volume decline is self-imposed risk tightening and funding, not demand.
findings.independence: Proxy: the company has not confirmed any transmission. Same data at https://finance.sina.cn/2026-11-13/detail-iniyqsna8023513.d.html.

outside_window.finding: Securities class action (E.D.N.Y.) lead-plaintiff deadline of 2026-11-27, alleging the company understated regulatory headwinds. Procedural, no cash impact in the window.
The next semi-annual dividend (H2 2026) is declared with Q4 results in March. The H1 dividend was $0.46/ADS at about a 30% payout, about 10% of the current price, and it was paid on about 1 Oct.

lessons_applied: Rule 6 (unsourced bar): no Q4 consensus could be sourced, so the Q4-guide finding was capped from -3.0 to -2.0.
Rule 3 / shared-fact check: the CEO-change finding acts through the same guide as finding 2 and is inference, so it was cut from -0.8 to -0.5.
Rule 8 and the reaction-history rebuild (baseline_history_trustworthy false): rebuilt from confirmed releases (-14.6, -8.45, -14.1, -18.9), so abs_move_pct went up from 14 to 15.
